title: Cross-domain MQ event envelope v1 (ADR-020, ADR-029 #15)
description: Every message published via sys_outbox to RocketMQ. Topic/event name pattern: tioka.{domain}.{event}.v{n}. Incompatible payload changes must bump the version suffix. Product tenant field is forbidden (ADR-029 #60). Optional requestId/subject for correlation (ADR-073).

eventId.description: ULID; consumers dedupe via sys_consumed(consumer, event_id).

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent for cross-async span linking (GOV-08).

replayOf.description: Original eventId when this message is a dead-letter replay (ORC-07).

requestId.description: Correlation request id (ADR-073); preserved on dead-letter replay.

hops.description: Derived-event depth; orchestration rejects beyond its limit.
